rules.title: Set TTLs
rules.text: Set expirations on cache keys and namespace key names (service:entity:id).

rules.title: SCAN, not KEYS
rules.text: Use SCAN instead of KEYS in production code.

rules.title: Not the source of truth
rules.text: Treat Redis as a cache unless persistence has been explicitly designed.

rules.title: Pipeline round trips
rules.text: Batch commands with pipelines to reduce round trips.
